name: Ransomware Halts City Services
description: Ransomware encrypts systems behind permits, utility billing, and municipal courts; services run on paper while systems are rebuilt from backups.
asset: Permitting, utility billing, and court systems
assumptions: No ransom is paid; costs are rebuild and manual operations.
Secondary loss covers delayed revenue and legal claims.

name: Water Utility SCADA Intrusion
description: An intruder reaches the water utility's control network; operations switch to manual and regulators are notified while systems are validated.
threat: Targeted intruder reaching the control network
assumptions: Public-safety impacts are handled as a separate (non-financial) analysis.
Any confirmed intrusion forces manual operation until revalidation.
Secondary loss covers regulatory penalties and mandated upgrades.

name: Vendor Payment Redirect
description: Using public procurement records, fraudsters impersonate a contractor and redirect a progress payment to an attacker-controlled account.
asset: Accounts payable and vendor master data
assumptions: Public bid records make impersonation attempts routine.
Bank recovery is reflected in the primary-loss estimates.
Secondary loss covers audit findings and process remediation.

name: Resident Records Breach
description: An attacker or misconfiguration exposes court, police, or utility customer records containing resident personal information.
asset: Court, police, and utility customer records
assumptions: Sealed or protected records multiply the impact if included.
Primary loss covers forensics, notification, and monitoring.
Secondary loss includes civil claims against the city.

name: Dispatch System Disruption
description: A cyber incident degrades computer-aided dispatch; call-takers fall back to radio and paper, slowing emergency response coordination.
assumptions: Life-safety impacts are handled as a separate (non-financial) analysis.
Radio fallback keeps dispatch functioning at reduced capacity.
Secondary loss covers liability claims tied to delayed response.
